github.//: Preview deploys OFF for every branch except master. The data workflows open a draft PR per refresh and pr-autoresolve pushes to each open branch every time master moves, so a dozen auto-generated data/* branches were each triggering their own preview build. Those builds share the free tier's daily quota with PRODUCTION, and once the quota is gone prod cannot deploy for 24h and never retries itself — a data-refresh PR nobody was waiting on could silently block the live dashboard. Nothing is lost: these branches only ever change JSON under platform/data/, which is reviewed in the PR diff, not by eye on a preview URL. Flip `enabled` back to true (or add a branch to deploymentEnabled) if a branch ever needs a visual review.
